name: Emergency Lighting Check
description: Corridors, stairwells, and vestibules must have emergency lighting
message: {room_name} (type: {condition_value}) lacks emergency lighting. Install self-contained luminaire.

name: Panel Water Clearance Check
description: Electrical panel must maintain safe distance from water sources
message: Panel is only {value}m from water source, {threshold}m minimum required. Relocate panel or provide IP-rated enclosure.

name: Circuit Load Check
description: Final circuit load must not exceed rated capacity (ring circuit up to 32A permitted)
message: Circuit load {value}A exceeds limit {threshold}A (ring circuit rating). Split circuit or use radial circuit.

name: Socket Outlet Coverage Check
description: Socket outlets provided for intended use; no hard spacing limit in SS 638
message: Outlet spacing {value}m exceeds advisory guideline {threshold}m. Additional outlets recommended based on point-of-use assessment.
